documents.title: Corporate Action - Record Date For The Purpose Of Dividend For The FY 2025-26
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Notice Of The 19Th Annual General Meeting Of The Company To Be Held On September 25, 2026

analysis.summary: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching INR 1,555 crores and profit after tax rising to INR 380 crores. Management highlighted record quarterly production across solar modules and cells, an expanded order book of 9.9 gigawatt, and steady progress on their 6 gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion. The company also outlined medium-term backward integration plans into ingot and wafer manufacturing subject to market conditions and ALMM List 3 clarity. Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd. reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching INR 15,555 million and PAT growing 103% YoY to INR 3,803 million.

guidance.claim: The company targets approximately INR 2,400 crore of EBITDA by the close of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27.

guidance.claim: Management stated that once completed, the new facility will take total installed capacity to 16.3 gigawatt for modules and 8.9 gigawatt for cells by the end of the FY2027 financial year.
guidance.quote: Once completed, this will take our total installed capacity to 16.3 gigawatt for modules and 8.9 gigawatt for cells by the end of FY2027 financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight, which should support the operating environment for established and compliant cell manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that order inflows reflect continued demand across utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and rooftop solar segments.
demand_outlook.quote: The order book provides healthy revenue visibility and reflects continued demand across utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and rooftop solar segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Order inflow of 1.5 GW during Q1FY27 reinforced demand momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: Order inflow of 1.5 GW during Q1FY27 reinforced demand momentum, while the 9.9 GW order book provides strong revenue visibility for the coming quarters

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that C&I has always been the fastest-growing sector and is similarly growing in their case as well.
demand_outlook.quote: And C&I has always been the fastest-growing sector in a long time, which you can see is similarly growing in our case as well.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that the demand outlook for a manufacturer like them has been strong.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand outlook for a manufacturer like us has been strong.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the 6-gigawatt integrated facility is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at a cost of less than 8% for the 6-gigawatt expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8%.

capex_expansion.claim: The backward integration facility for ingot and wafer manufacturing will have a total capacity of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases.
capex_expansion.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a 2.5 gigawatt module manufacturing line in May 2025 and another 2.5 gigawatt line in December 2025 at Sulibele, Bengaluru.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, we commissioned a 2.5 gigawatt module manufacturing line in May 2025 and another 2.5 gigawatt line in December 2025 at Sulibele, Bengaluru.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they have initiated plans for a new 6 gigawatt integrated cell and module manufacturing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: We have initiated plans for our new 6 gigawatt integrated cell and module manufacturing facility.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects to see the module line getting commissioned by the end of this calendar year and the cell line getting commissioned atmanufacturing facility the end of this financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: and we expect to see the module line getting commissioned by the end of this calendar year and the cell line getting commissioned at the end of this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated their intention to set up an ingot and wafer facility of about 9 gigawatt integrating fully in phases.
capex_expansion.quote: And with that, we intend to set up an ingot and wafer facility of about 9 gigawatt integrating us fully in phases.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they plan to set up their first ingot and wafer facility in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And we plan to set up our first facility in FY29.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1FY27 improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: An EBITDA margin improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax margin improved to 24% in Q1FY27 compared to 18% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 24% compared to 18% in the corresponding quarter last year and 23% in the previous quarter, due to lower finance costs that reduced significantly to INR 11.1 crores compared to INR 53.1 crores in Q1FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Gross Profit for Q1FY27 was INR 6,773 million with a gross profit margin of 44%.
EBITDA margin expanded to 34% compared to 31% in the previous year, supported by scale benefits, operating leverage, higher module production and better utilization of cell manufacturing capacity.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 34% compared to 31% in the previous year. This improvement was supported by scale benefits, operating leverage, higher module production and better utilization of our cell manufacturing capacity.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved to 21% compared to 16% in FY2025, supported by strong EBITDA growth and lower finance cost intensity after balance sheet deleveraging.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 21% compared to 16% in FY2025. The improvement in profitability was supported by strong EBITDA growth and lower finance cost intensity after balance sheet deleveraging.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt at the end of Q1FY27, supported by fresh order inflows of approximately 1.5 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows and approximately 1.5 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.

orders_capacity.claim: Order inflow for Q1FY27 was 1,484 MW.
The company's installed solar module capacity increased to 10.3 gigawatt as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our installed solar module capacity increased to 10.3 gigawatt as of March 31, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: Solar cell installed capacity stood at 2.94 gigawatt as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our solar cell installed capacity stood at 2.94 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book increased from 4.9 gigawatt in FY25 to 9.4 gigawatt in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book increased from 4.9 gigawatt in FY25 to 9.4 gigawatt in FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: For Q4 FY26, order inflow stood at 1.27 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: For Q4 FY26, order inflow stood at 1.27 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Solar cell capacity utilization increased from 43.3% in FY2025 to 69.9% in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Solar cell capacity utilization increased from 43.3% in FY2025 to 69.9% in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: The 9 GW ingot and wafer backward integration capex is to be funded largely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: To be funded largely through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed its IPO and public listing in November 2025, raising INR 2,900 crores, including INR 2,144 crores of fresh issue proceeds.
capital_allocation.quote: We completed our IPO and public listing in November 2025, raising INR2,900 crores, including INR2,144 crores of fresh issue proceeds.

capital_allocation.claim: The company used approximately INR 1,621 crores of IPO proceeds to prepay term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: We used approximately INR1,621 crores of IPO proceeds to prepay term loans.

capital_allocation.claim: IREDA sanctioned a term loan of INR 3,306 crores for the 6 gigawatt facility.
capital_allocation.quote: IREDA has sanctioned our term loan for INR3,306 crores for this facility.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that competition will increase, technology will evolve, trade rules will change, and logistic and commodity cycles may remain volatile.
risks_headwinds.quote: Competition will increase, technology will evolve, trade rules will change, logistic and commodity cycles may remain volatile.

management_commitments.claim: The module line of the 6-gigawatt integrated facility is expected to be commissioned by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Following the completion of this expansion, our total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.

management_commitments.claim: Backward integration into ingot and wafer manufacturing is planned with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and 4 gigawatt in FY2030.
management_commitments.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they expect to see the module line getting commissioned by the end of this calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: and we expect to see the module line getting commissioned by the end of this calendar year

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they expect the cell line to get commissioned at the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: and the cell line getting commissioned at the end of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated their intention to set up their first ingot and wafer facility in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And we plan to set up our first facility in FY29.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
